label: a camera.
why: A film camera is seen straight on in close-up, its round lens with ringed bezels filling the centre of the frame, and the camera holds almost still with only slight shifts of the lens and light. Cuts fall at 4.0, 5.75 and 12.0 s, and the earlier studio shot has the camera partly hidden by its operator, so this last 3 s shot is the one where the camera is unobstructed throughout.
